## Concepts, Owners And Complete Consumption

The chosen family is the eight physical run-identity observations across five
complete served reset/admission/diagnostic declarations. The separately
authorized repair closes the status-count/independent-process-inspection
manifestation. Immediate parent: #2542 fixture/observation authority migration;
broader parent: #2151 confinement. The issue is not symptom-shaped. The initial
run queries were entry points; the full reader acquisition, snapshot, error,
crash/recovery/reset and immutable-history chains were audited.

Canonical owners are unchanged: storetest.CountPhysicalRunIdentity delegates
through runtimepersistence.CountPhysicalRunIdentityForTest to
runlifecycle.CountRunIdentityStorageTx. The new readServedRunPhysicalIdentity
composes that detached scalar inside the captured original reader's existing
InspectSnapshot. It never opens/reconstructs a writer, recovers SQL or narrows
the physical predicate. Native UUID casting versus SQLite lexical identity,
error propagation and transaction acknowledgment remain authoritative below
the bridge. One independent snapshot per original count; no aggregate cut.
